runnerContract.selectionRule: Inspect live repository and organization self-hosted runner availability before changing workflow routing. Use a compatible online self-hosted runner when available; otherwise use the pinned windows-2025 GitHub-hosted fallback. The current workflows use the fallback because no compatible repository runner was online when this contract was refreshed.

dependencies.name: GitHub Pages actions and tar.exe
dependencies.source: GitHub Actions plus git-for-windows/git canonical releases
dependencies.bootstrap: The tool bootstrap supplies tar from verified portable MinGit when the pinned image lacks it; the job then archives, uploads, deploys, and records safe evidence.

bootstrap.freshEnvironmentProof: Run both phases on a disposable Windows x64 environment with an empty npm cache and no design/node_modules directory. Cache misses remain supported; no manual preparation or pre-populated node_modules directory is allowed.
bootstrap.cacheMissPolicy: Every workflow declares and bootstraps its own dependencies. Caches may accelerate downloads but never replace the install path.

policy.codeSigning: Prohibited. The workflow clears inherited signing inputs, keeps forceCodeSigning and signAndEditExecutable false, and verifies Setup.exe is NotSigned.
policy.qualityChecks: GitHub Actions runs no tests, lint, type checking, static analysis, coverage, accessibility checks, or screenshots. Those checks remain local task evidence and never gate publication.
policy.releaseChannel: Every successful push or manual release workflow publishes one unique stable release after build, package, publication, and remote asset checks.
policy.extension: Publish a version-stamped ZIP for Chrome's Load unpacked flow. Do not create or require a CRX while signing and private keys remain prohibited.
policy.pages: The Pages workflow builds, deploys, verifies the live response, and collects safe evidence without a quality-check step.
